learning_outcomes.text: Express basic vocabulary and frequently used daily expressions in sign language.

Explain the sentence structure, grammatical features of T
R

, and its differences from Turkish.
Use facial expressions, gestures, and body language effectively in sign language communication.
Gain awareness of Deaf culture, the communication needs of hearing-impaired individuals, and communication ethics.
Communicate interactively at a basic level in sign language and express themselves.

syllabus_topics:
Course introduction; introduction to sign language and Deaf culture; T
R

 alphabet
Hand shapes, fingerspelling practice, basic greetings
Personal pronouns, introductions, asking names, simple sentences
Family members, close environment, possession concepts
Daily routines, time expressions (day, hour, morning/evening)
Food and drinks, shopping, restaurant dialogues
Sentence structure, question types, negation; dialogue practice
School and work life, professions, hobbies
Current topics, general conversation, cultural sharing
